features.text: Advanced CoolFlex sleeve technology minimizes heat buildup and manages moisture during activity
Specialized stabilization system ensures proper patellar tracking through full range of motion
Strategic compression design provides secure anchoring without migration
Breathable materials maintain comfort during extended athletic activity
Professional-grade support perfect for both athletic performance and recovery

measurement: For optimal therapeutic benefits and support, measure the circumference of your knee at the center of the patella. Visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for detailed sizing guidance and expert fitting assistance.
